newsitem.title: UK: Devro has 92.9 pct of Czech Cutisin.
newsitem.headline: Devro has 92.9 pct of Czech Cutisin.

text.p: Scottish-based sausage skin maker Devro Plc said on Friday that its subsidiary Devro B.V. had an effective interest of 92.9 percent in Cutisin following a public offer for the Czech-based firm.

Devro said in a statement that shareholder approval for Cutisin to de-list its shares from the Prague Stock Exchange had been given on December 20 and the de-listing would become effective in six months' time.

After this Cutisin, a manufacturer of edible and non-edible collagen casings with three plants in the Czech Republic, will be required to make a final offer to the remaining minority shareholders, Devro added.
Devro made its offer for Cutisin in October last year when it owned 56.5 percent of its shares, acquired in January 1996 as part of the purchase of Teepak International.
